newsitem.title: USA: Federal Express plane crashes in Newark.
newsitem.headline: Federal Express plane crashes in Newark.

text.p: A Federal Express MD-11 airplane crashed on landing at Newark International Airport early Thursday, but all seven people on board got out alive, a spokesman for the New York/New Jersey Port Authority said.
The two pilots and five other people on the Fedex cargo plane all suffered unspecified injuries and were taken to local hospitals, Port Authority spokesman John Mariano said in a telephone interview.
"They're alive but they're hurt. I don't know how bad," he said.
The cargo plane crashed at about 1:35 a.m. EDT and burst into flames. The airport was immediately closed as rescue crews raced to the crash site at Terminal A.
"The airport automatically closes when a plane goes down like that," said Mariano.
The wide-body aircraft had left from Anchorage, Alaska, according to Warren Perkins, a Federal Express Hub Command Centre agent, who spoke in a telephone interview from Memphis.
"It is one of the larger types of aircraft in our fleet," Perkins said.
